name: grid/setup-check
description: Diagnose grid setup: Tailscale install, connectivity, HTTPS certs, peers, Docker grid profile, and actionable fix steps. Run this to see what's needed before enabling distributed compute.

results.name: ready
results.description: True if grid is fully operational (Tailscale connected, transport listening)

results.name: tailscaleIp
results.description: This node's Tailscale IP (null if not connected)

results.name: dnsName
results.description: This node's Tailscale DNS name (e.g., bigmama.tailnet-name.ts.net)

results.name: checks
results.description: Diagnostic checks: { check, status (pass|fail|warn|info|skip), detail, peers? }

results.name: actions
results.description: Ordered list of actionable fix steps (empty if everything passes)
